## GSE214411
EMS= EuE endo
N= EuE control

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
data_dir_EMS1 <- "~/Downloads/Alpha_Beta_Paper/GSE214411_RAW/EMS1"
list.files(data_dir_EMS1) # Should show barcodes.tsv.gz, features.tsv.gz, and matrix.mtx.gz
EMS1 <- Read10X(data.dir = data_dir_EMS1)
EMS1 <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = EMS1, project = "EMS1", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)

GSE214411_CEuE <- merge(N1, y=c(N2,N3,N4,N5,N6,N7), add.cell.ids = c("N1","N2","N3","N4","N5","N6","N7"))
```

EMS1
```{r}
# Get the expression matrix (log-normalized data)
expr_data <- GetAssayData(EMS1, slot = "counts")


# Check which cells express ESR1 and/or ESR2
esr1_expr <- expr_data["ESR1", ] > 0
esr2_expr <- expr_data["ESR2", ] > 0

# Boolean logic to define each group
both     <- esr1_expr & esr2_expr
esr1_only <- esr1_expr & !esr2_expr
esr2_only <- !esr1_expr & esr2_expr
neither  <- !esr1_expr & !esr2_expr

# Count cells in each group
counts <- list(
  ESR1_only = sum(esr1_only),
  ESR2_only = sum(esr2_only),
  Both      = sum(both),
  Neither   = sum(neither)
)

print(counts)

```
